defaultRunOptions$comment: Measured on Apify on 2026-11-03 at 1024 MB (actor 88vUTMQIi2COsKvYQ, build 1.0.1, engine v0.4.0, unpriced): the example input (run 6uFK1C6wG1NyXXCyO) took 157 s with a peak of 256 MiB, downloading Workable's whole feed (145,056,677 bytes, 138 MiB) and parsing about 860 MB of XML, usageTotalUsd $0.0094; the empty form (run 7XF3iMyDlPMqHCzpz) read 300 of 300 career pages in 155 s with a peak of 221 MiB, $0.0093. Both take about 2.5 minutes, well inside the daily test's 5, so the default stays 1024 MB (decision 2026-11-03). 2048 MB was not run: the empty form is paced at 2 calls a second, so more memory would not shorten it, and the run start bills once per GB, so a 2 GB default would make it $0.02 a run. minMemoryMbytes is 1024 in actor.json, as on the other v0.4.0 job actors: at 512 MB the feed parse gets an eighth of a core and takes twice as long for the same compute, so a smaller run saves nobody anything. Laptop peaks on engine v0.4.0 from the local copy of three quarters of the feed: the example 186 MB, the whole copy with no filter 246 MB.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02, measured on Apify on 2026-11-03. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor by users for Workable's job: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api, 1,632 u30, $0.012 a job plus $0.01 a run on FREE (BRONZE $0.012 plus $0.0001, GOLD $0.004), a 58-ATS database where workable is one filter. Anchors for the same job, every Workable company searched by keyword with no list: factpipe/ats-jobs-feed $0.003 (98 u30) and jtpalms/ats-jobs-index $0.003 plus $0.00005 (60 u30), multi-ATS indexes whose rows carry the description; made for Workable: jobo.world/workable-jobs-scraper-api $0.004 a row with the description (7 u30, its own database), shahidirfan/Workable-Job-Scraper $0.001 plus $0.005 (11 u30) and api-co's Workable actor (the plural slug) $0.00075 FREE, $0.0015 BRONZE (1 u30), both through Workable's job board search. Here 100 rows cost $0.26 with the start, 13% under the indexes' $0.30, and carry no description; job-details is 12.5% under jobo.world's $0.004 and above the indexes' $0.003, because each details row is a live call to apply.workable.com, which allows about 2 a second. The same job and job-details prices as smartrecruiters-jobs-search and deel-jobs-search. Start fee: every search by word reads Workable's whole feed, whatever it finds. Measured on Apify on 2026-11-03 at 1024 MB (build 1.0.1, engine v0.4.0): the example input (run 6uFK1C6wG1NyXXCyO) received 145,056,677 bytes (138 MiB, the whole feed) in 157 s, usageTotalUsd $0.0094, of which compute $0.0087 (0.0437 CU) and external transfer $0.00004 (0.00019 GB). Apify bills outbound traffic as external transfer, not inbound downloads, so the feed costs compute time only; the 2026-11-02 estimate of about $0.026 of transfer a run was wrong. The empty form (run 7XF3iMyDlPMqHCzpz) cost $0.0093. The $0.01 start covers that fixed work of reading the whole feed on every word search, and a 100-row run at 1 GB keeps a 95.5% margin on FREE and 96.3% on GOLD, so the prices stay as they are (decision 2026-11-03). The start event is defined at the first pricing because adding one later needs Console and 14 days' notice, while a cut takes effect at once: cut it to Apify's default $0.00005 if the Console quality tab flags ACTOR_START_PRICE. The start is charged at the start of every run, also a link check, a named company and a run Workable refuses. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29; the start stays flat (SEO.md 16.7). apply is true since the measurement; isPublic stays false until the publish step.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, every place, work type, job type, department, posting date, job and apply links, company website. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description, requirements and benefits as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its period when shown, the company's job code, city, region and country.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory (the default) and once more for each extra GB. It covers the fixed work of reading Workable's whole feed, about 140 MB compressed, that every search by word does whatever it finds.
